description: This source file defines the PreferLocalPlacementDirector class, which implements a placement strategy for grain activation in Orleans. It extends the RandomPlacementDirector and attempts to prefer placing new grains on the local silo, unless the local silo is not active or incompatible.

classes.name: PreferLocalPlacementDirector
classes.description: A placement director that prefers placing new grain activations on the local silo, falling back to random placement otherwise.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Handles the logic for selecting a silo for a new activation, preferring the local silo if it is active and compatible, otherwise defers to the base class.
